_comment: Authored step instructions for the Set-grammar parity check (stories/variable-assignment.md). ONE list, three readers: the runtime parser (tests/set-step.test.ts pins what it does), the Steptix completion/F12 scanner and the webview Variables panel (steptix-vscode/tests/set-step-mirrors.test.js pins that they AGREE with it, by calling it). Adding a row here is how a new grammar case gets checked everywhere at once — which is the thing hand-copied tables kept failing to do.
